Name: MH Quest Manager
Author: mahsouto
Description:
[size=6][b][center]MH Quest Manager[/center][/b][/size]
A comprehensive quest management tool for Stardew Valley. Browse, filter, and track all your active, completed, and modded quests with an intuitive interface. Perfect for players who want full control over their quest log and never miss a deadline.


[b][size=4]Features
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Works with vanilla quests, special orders, Mr. Qi challenges, and modded quests[/size]
[size=2]
[/size][/list][list]
[*]Filtering and search system
[list]
[*]View Active, Ready to Collect, Completed, Favorites, or All quests
[*]Search across quest names, descriptions, NPCs, and mod sources
[*]Sort by Name, Age, or Deadline (ascending/descending)
[*]Filter results update in real-time
[/list][*]Quest information
[list]
[*]View all objectives with live progress tracking
[*]See required items with inventory count
[*]Quest giver and target NPC information
[*]Deadline countdown with warnings
[*]Reward preview (gold, items, friendship)
[/list][*]Quality of life features
[list]
[*]Pin up to 3 quests to a floating overlay
[*]Mark quests as favorites for quick access
[*]Dark and light theme support
[*]Overlay with customizable position
[/list][*]Optional cheat features (configurable) (disabled by default)
[list]
[*]Teleport to quest NPCs
[*]Instantly complete quests
[*]Reset quest deadlines
[*]Spawn required items
[/list][/list]
[size=4][b]How to Use
[/b]
[/size][list]
[*]Press J (or your configured key) to open the MH Quest Manager panel
[*]Browse and filter your quests using the view tabs and search box
[*]Click on any quest to see full details in the right panel
[*]Pin important quests to the overlay for easy progress tracking
[*]Use "View Details" for an expanded full-screen view
[/list]
[size=4][b]Note[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]It does not replace the vanilla manager.
[/list]
